entries.name: TYPEFORM_ACCESS_TOKEN
entries.description: A Typeform personal access token for the account that owns the forms, used to read their definitions and responses.
howToGet: In Typeform, open Account > Personal tokens and generate a new token for KaratOS.
Give it only the forms:read and responses:read scopes. Typeform can't report a token's scopes, so nothing checks this later; the connector only sends GET requests either way.
Copy the token straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: TYPEFORM_FORM_IDS
entries.description: The Typeform forms to read, by id, separated by commas. Not a secret.
howToGet: A form's id is the last part of its link: in https://example.typeform.com/to/u6nXL7 it is u6nXL7.

entries.name: TYPEFORM_API_HOST
entries.description: Which Typeform host the account keeps its responses on: api.typeform.com, api.eu.typeform.com or api.typeform.eu for the newer EU data center. api.typeform.com when empty; the sync stops with the right host named if it is wrong.
howToGet: Leave empty unless the account is on an EU data center; the first sync says which host to set if it is.

entries.name: TYPEFORM_WEBHOOK_SECRET
entries.description: The secret set on a Typeform webhook, which signs each delivery (Typeform-Signature). Only needed once webhooks are turned on; the scheduled sync works without it.
howToGet: Generated by npm run secrets:setup. Set the same value as the secret on each form's webhook in Typeform.

entries.name: FORMS_MAPPING_PROFILE
entries.description: How the forms are built: generic, or the path to a form mapping profile JSON kept in the client's private instance repo.
howToGet: Leave as generic when the forms use the question names in docs/integrations.md.
Otherwise write a profile for the client's forms in their private instance repo and put its path here.
